claim.claim-text: 1. A solid form formulation comprising or, alternatively, consisting of:

2. The formulation according to claim 1, wherein said solid form formulation further comprises: (d) a starch of plant origin, preferably gelatinised or pre-gelatinised; more preferably selected from rice starch, soy starch or corn starch; even more preferably wherein said (d) is pre-gelatinised rice starch.

3. The formulation according to any one of claims 1 or 2, wherein said (a-I) at least one vitamin of group B is selected from the group comprising or, alternatively, consisting of: vitamin B12, vitamin B9, vitamin B6, vitamin B3, vitamin B2 and mixture thereof; preferably said (a-I) at least one vitamin of group B being vitamin B12.

4. The formulation according to any one of claims 1-3, wherein said (a-III) a vitamin D is selected from the group comprising or, alternatively, consisting of: vitamin D2, vitamin D3 and mixture thereof; preferably said (a-III) a vitamin D being vitamin D3.

5. The formulation according to any one of claims 1-4, wherein said (b) at least one phospholipid is a phosphoglyceride, more preferably said phospholipid is a phosphatidylcholine or lecithin, even more preferably said phospholipid is a lecithin (E322) selected from sunflower lecithin, corn lecithin, soy lecithin and mixtures thereof; still even more preferably wherein said lecithin is a non-hydrolysed lecithin.

6. The formulation according to any one of claims 1-5, wherein said (c-i) at least one sucrester or fatty acid carbohydrate ester comprises from 70% by weight to 90% by weight, with respect to the total weight of the sucrester, of monoesters obtained by esterification of sucrose with one or more fatty acids of plant origin, preferably stearic acid and/or palmitic acid; preferably sucrester (E473).
7. The formulation according to any one of claims 1-6, wherein said solid form formulation comprises or, alternatively, consists of:

8. The formulation according to any one of claims 1-7, wherein a weight ratio (c-i) sucrester: (b) phospholipid is comprised from 50:1 to 10:1, preferably from 40:1 to 10:1, more preferably from 30:1 to 15:1; preferably wherein said (b) phospholipid is a lecithin.

9. The formulation according to any one of claims 1-8, wherein said b) phospholipid, preferably phosphatidylcholine or lecithin, more preferably sunflower lecithin, is comprised in said formulation, in an amount, expressed as % by weight with respect to the total weight of the formulation, in a range from 0.05% to 10%, preferably from about 0.1% to 2%.

10. The formulation according to any one of claims 1-9, wherein said (c-i) a sucrester or a fatty acid carbohydrate ester, is comprised in said formulation, in an amount, expressed as % by weight with respect to the total weight of the formulation, in a range from 1% to 50%, preferably from about 10% to 25%.
11. A composition comprising or, alternatively, consisting of:
- the solid form formulation of chromium according to any one of claims 1-10; and - at least one acceptable pharmaceutical or food grade additive and/or excipient.
12. The formulation or composition according to any one of the preceding claims for use as medicament.

13. The formulation or composition according to any one of claims 1-12 for use in a method for the preventive and/or curative treatment and/or adjuvant treatment of an insufficiency and/or deficiency of said vitamins and of diseases and/or symptoms related to said deficiency, or for use in the supplementation of one of said vitamins, in subjects in need.

14. The formulation or composition for use according to claim 12 or 13, wherein said formulation or composition is for use in a method for the preventive and/or curative and/or adjuvant treatment of a cognitive disorders or change in the cognitive-emotional sphere, cardiometabolic disorders, change in the immune system, stress related to anxiety and depression, fatigue, chronic fatigue and/or asthenia, infections or inflammation of the mucous membranes or the skin, delayed bone growth, problems related to wound healing, and other diseases or symptoms detailed hereinafter, in subjects in need.

15. The formulation or composition for use according to any one of claims 12-14, wherein said formulation or composition comprises at least one vitamin of group B, preferably vitamin B12, and is used for preventing, reducing or treating a vitamin B deficiency and/or symptoms related to said deficiency including: weakness and physical fatigue, shortness of breath, tingling at the tips, memory loss or cognitive difficulties, difficulty in walking due to balance problems, hallucinations, anaemia, and pallor.

16. The formulation or composition for use according to any one of claims 12-14, wherein said formulation or composition comprises at least a vitamin D, preferably vitamin D3, and is used for preventing, reducing or treating a vitamin D deficiency and/or symptoms related to said deficiency including: rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults (due to an alteration of bone mineralization), osteoporosis, and hyperparathyroidism, changes in the immune system.

17. The formulation or composition for use according to any one of claims 12-14, wherein said formulation or composition comprises at least a vitamin C and is used for preventing, reducing or treating a vitamin C deficiency and/or symptoms related to said deficiency including: fatigue, depression, connective tissue disorders, gingivitis, petechiae, skin rashes, internal bleeding and delayed wound healing, brittleness of the nails, skin and hair following inflammation or medical treatment, and altered bone growth in children, change in the immune system, oxidative stress, decreased iron absorption.

18. The formulation or composition for use according to any one of claims 12-14, wherein said formulation or composition comprises at least a vitamin E and is used for preventing, reducing or treating a vitamin E deficiency and/or symptoms related to said deficiency including: a lack of reflexes and coordination, difficulty walking, muscle weakness, a form of anaemia in which red blood cells are destroyed (haemolytic anaemia), hair loss, skin diseases, weak immune system, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, vision problems, and loss of muscle tone, oxidative stress.
19. Non-therapeutic or cosmetic use of the formulation or composition according to any one of claims 1-11.
20. A process for the preparation of the solid form formulation of at least one vitamin according to any one of claims 1 to 10 comprising the steps of:
21. A process for the preparation of the composition according to claim 11 comprising the steps of:

- (i) preparing a solid form formulation of at least one vitamin according to any one of claims 1 to 10 or producing a solid form formulation of at least one vitamin according to claim 18, to obtain said solid form formulation of at least one vitamin; - (ii) mixing said solid form formulation of at least one vitamin of step (i) with at least one additive and/or excipient to obtain the composition.
